usageRules.sourceOfTruth: Only confirmed values in this file are canonical. pending-confirmation.json keeps unresolved cross-spec conflicts. boardAssembly.latestEventId stays source-owned to S3-2 board fixtures, while S8 owner fixtures keep their own domain-event expectations in separate fields.

incidentSeed.accountIdMeaning: accountIds are internal account.id UUIDs. accountCodes carry acct-* login/fixture codes and mock 112 import maps those codes to UUIDs before writing incident_assignment.account_id.

mock112SourceContract.title: 종로구 인왕산 실종 신고
mock112SourceContract.syntheticDataNote: All names, locations, and identifiers are synthetic test fixtures. Do not replace with real personal data.

assignmentShape.accountCodeSource: mock-112 fixture account code mapped to S1-2 account UUID
assignmentShape.accountCodeMeaning: The value carries acct-* fixture account code, not DB account.id UUID.

mock112SourceContract.duplicateImportRule: Same sourceIncidentId resolves via existing incident reuse or write_conflict; no duplicate incident, OP, incident_assignment, or initial marker creation.
mock112SourceContract.assignmentDedupeRule: Same incident_id + account_id + revoked_at IS NULL or processed externalAssignmentKey skips duplicate insert.
mock112SourceContract.missingSourceIncidentNote: Fixture preflight blocks loading any common fixture set whose mock112SourceContract.sourceIncidentId is missing. No public API error code is added. Lane red tests use fixture preflight failure as the canonical signal.
mock112SourceContract.sc02HandoverNote: SC-02 handover fixtures reuse the mock 112 polling/import adapter path. No separate harness-only handover loader is introduced. Adapter sees the same handoverAssignments shape as initialAssignments.

readOnlyGeometryHash.expected: SC-11 evidence uses canonical LineString geometry and SearchPath.version

staleVersion.expected: mock board ignores event payloads below current version

restartNoBridge.expected: recording restart creates a new search_path and board does not bridge separate LineStrings

clockRules.enqueueRule: clockOffsetMs와 clockSyncedAt이 없거나 5분보다 오래됐으면 /api/sync/clock 성공 전 SENDING 전이를 금지한다.
clockRules.serverRule: domain write의 clientTs + clockOffsetMs가 server receive time 기준 30초를 초과해 벗어나면 409 clock_skew_exceeded를 반환하고 row는 FAILED_RETRYABLE로 남긴다.

relationToBoardAssembly.meaning: boardAssembly keeps the base stale package_badge row; this probe is the expected post-replay S7 convergence state.

sc08EmptyFcmRecipientSkip.uiExpectation: No user-facing notification failure is shown; board/toast convergence is verified through S3-2 mock refetch output only.
